verdict.rationale: LlamaParse's SDK/REST/CLI interface and webhook-based job notifications (rather than polling) imply that users can programmatically submit and track many parse jobs at once, and the API-first design (Python/TS/Go/Java/CLI/REST) supports scripting bulk workflows. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated batch/bulk submission endpoint, batch job status API, or bulk pricing/rate-limit guidance for large-scale runs. Missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk API endpoint documentation, evidence of concurrency/rate limits for many simultaneous jobs, and hands-on confirmation of bulk operation success.
